description: At Sri Guru Ramdas Ji International Airport, chaos erupted as a SpiceJet flight to Dubai experienced an extraordinary delay of nearly eighteen hours. Frustration mounted among passengers due to persistent schedule changes and a lack of clear communication from the airline. This situation prompted worries about missed work obligations and travel plans, while many sought refunds, specifically criticizing the airline for not providing accommodations during the lengthy wait.

Police have arrested the woman and registered a case against her.

This acquisition will significantly enhance the air defence capabilities of India on multiple fronts. The delivery is anticipated to commence approximately three years post-signing, allowing for substantial protection against various aerial threats.

description: In a heartbreaking incident in Faridabad, a 26-year-old man died after jumping in front of a train. The young man had been dealing with significant mental health challenges following the recent death of his mother from cancer. After a family celebration of Raksha Bandhan on Saturday, he departed home shortly after preparing a meal for his father, leading to a tragic discovery by the railway police the next day.

He pointed out a growing distrust in the government's promises regarding education and job opportunities. Emphasizing that protests become necessary when dialogue fails, Dipke underscored the critical importance of providing quality education for children from the Maratha community. He intends to meet with Jarange Patil to extend his support for the demonstration.

title: 1,300 days, 36 innings, no 100: How Babar’s Test century drought became a long story
description: Babar Azam's quest for a Test century continues as he remains without a hundred since December 2022. Over the course of seventeen Tests and thirty-six innings, he has frequently come close with several fifties but has yet to convert those into three-figure scores. His challenges surged notably in 2024, despite a temporary revival in South Africa.

title: After renaming ‘Gulf of Mexico’ to ‘Gulf of America’, Google Maps changes name of ‘Lake Ontario’
description: Google Maps has introduced a noteworthy update, displaying Lake Ontario as Lake America for American users. This decision aligns with a new presidential executive order and modifications to the GNIS. Canadian officials maintain the traditional name, highlighting its rich heritage over centuries. Meanwhile, alternative mapping platforms such as MapQuest and Apple Maps have not yet responded to this change, which is tailored regionally depending on the user's location.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes donate $1.077M to 20 Kansas City charities
description: The Mahomes Foundation gala achieved a remarkable feat, raising more than one million dollars for charitable organizations in Kansas City. The evening benefited twenty local entities, making a substantial difference in the community. Brittany Mahomes shared her heartfelt appreciation for the positive influence they continue to have, emphasizing the foundation's dedication to children's health and community development through a variety of supportive initiatives.

title: Imran Khan row: PCB warns Pak players against speaking about jailed former captain
description: The Pakistan Cricket Board has instructed its players to refrain from making public comments about Imran Khan's health amidst his ongoing imprisonment and health concerns that have drawn international interest. The board deems an interview with Khan's sons as politically motivated. Former cricketers Moin Khan and Javed Miandad have voiced their support for his medical needs, while international cricket captains have reached out to Pakistan's Prime Minister regarding his situation.

This disruption inconvenienced many passengers who had booked tickets in advance. Meanwhile, rainfall across Himachal Pradesh led to sixty-four road closures. The woman, a Dalit, was returning to her village for Raksha Bandhan. Police recovered the victim's mobile phone and stimulant tablets from the accused. An FIR was registered under murder and rape sections of the BNS.

description: Logan Paul and The Miz have taken very different paths to financial success in WWE. Paul has mixed digital media, boxing, wrestling and entrepreneurship, with PRIME Hydration playing a large part in his estimated fortune. The Miz, whose real name is Michael Gregory Mizanin, has amassed a fortune from a long career in WWE, reality television, acting, hosting, and other entertainment endeavors.

The company is consolidating multiple applications and systems into a single enterprise platform.  This comprehensive change aims to simplify processes and enhance data flow across departments.  The transformation is designed to prepare Dell for an AI-driven business environment.

title: Kabul, Kashmir, Mumbai, Pahalgam: Hafiz Saeed’s deadly four-decade terror trail
description: India has formally charged Hafiz Muhammad Saeed, the founder of Lashkar-e-Taiba, in connection with a new case of terrorism. The Mumbai Police have initiated proceedings for a trial in absentia, highlighting the legacy of LeT across various phases. Originating from the Afghan jihad in the 1980s, the organization has transitioned from focusing on Kashmir insurgency to embracing a wider range of terror operations.

title: How to avoid rental disputes: Delhi Police plans awareness session for Northeast tenants
description: Delhi Police will host an awareness program next week for Northeast residents.  The event will focus on rental agreements and security deposit issues.  Tenants will learn about their rights and responsibilities regarding rent.  Police will widely circulate advisories with community leaders' help.  This initiative aims to prevent and resolve landlord-tenant disputes effectively.

Utilizing cutting-edge microwave technology, the project vaporizes rock instead of using conventional drill bits. Collaboration with Nabors Industries will provide essential drilling expertise and equipment. The Obsidian Project, located in Oregon, is set to generate 50 MW by 2030, paving the way for a sustainable energy future.

title: Hollywood Video founder's unfinished Oregon mansion listed for $4.7m

Hollywood Video founder Mark Wattles bought the 32-acre property for $1.25 million in 1994 and spent about $12 million on the project. Two later owners also had plans for the estate, but the mansion was never completed.

title: Andre Agassi and Steffi Graf’s unique approach to raising their children
description: Andre Agassi made significant sacrifices during his own childhood to ensure his children could experience life freely. Becoming a father to Jaden and Jaz shifted his priorities, emphasizing their happiness over his own athletic legacy. His wife, Steffi Graf, who also faced the rigorous demands of elite sports, shared this perspective, allowing them to focus on nurturing their children's individual passions.
